newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Somague hits highs, upside seen.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Somague hits highs, upside seen.

text.p: Portuguese construction company Somague-SGPS hit a high of 2,320 escudos per share on Tuesday boosted by optimism over the sector's prospects and some broker recommendations, traders said.

The stock subsequently eased slightly to 2,305 escudos but was still over four percent up on the day. Traders said it could target 2,400 escudos in the short-term with 2,500 a more distant goal. "Some speak of 2,500 escudos," said one trader.
"It could seem a bit speculative at the moment but Somague has a strong order book and the building sector is growing, particularly with regard to public works," he added.
